name: chair
trans: n. a seat for one person, with a support for the back; the position of professor

name: desk
trans: n. a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments

name: blackboard
trans: n. sheet of slate; for writing with chalk

name: on
trans: prep. touching and supported by the top surface of
prep. about; concerning; on a particular day
adv. continuing; in operation

name: under
trans: prep. beneath; below; less than

name: in
trans: prep. inside; contained by; during
adv. into a place; at home

name: where
trans: adv. in or to what place
conj. at, in or to the place in which

name: the
trans: art. used before a noun to refer to a particular, known or unique person or thing

name: light
trans: n. (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation; any device serving as a source of illumination
adj. of comparatively little physical weight or density; (used of color) having a relatively small amount of coloring agent
v. make lighter or brighter; begin to smoke

name: bed
trans: n. a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep; a plot of ground in which plants are growing

name: door
trans: n. a swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle

name: box
trans: n. a (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid; private area in a theater or grandstand where a small group can watch the performance
v. put into a box

name: near
trans: prep. / adv. at or to a short distance from
adj. close in space or time

name: behind
trans: prep. / adv. at or towards the back of

name: plane
trans: n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets; (mathematics) an unbounded two-dimensional shape
v. cut or remove with or as if with a plane
adj. having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another

name: ball
trans: n. round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games; a solid projectile that is shot by a musket
v. form into a ball by winding or rolling

name: doll
trans: n. a small replica of a person; used as a toy

name: train
trans: v. create by training and teaching; undergo training or instruction in preparation for a particular role, function, or profession
n. public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

name: car
trans: n. a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine; a wheeled vehicle adapted to the rails of railroad

name: bear
trans: v. have; cause to be born
n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws

name: can
trans: aux. to be able to; to be allowed to
n. a metal container for food or drink

name: sure
trans: adj. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured; exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
adv. definitely or positively ('sure' is sometimes used informally for 'surely')

name: sorry
trans: adj. feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone; bad; unfortunate

name: rice
trans: n. grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished; annual or perennial rhizomatous marsh grasses; seed used for food; straw used for paper

name: noodles
trans: n. a ribbonlike strip of pasta

name: vegetable
trans: n. edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant

name: fish
trans: n. any of various mostly cold-blooded aquatic vertebrates usually having scales and breathing through gills; the flesh of fish used as food
v. seek indirectly; catch or try to catch fish or shellfish

name: chicken
trans: n. the flesh of a chicken used for food; a domestic fowl bred for flesh or eggs; believed to have been developed from the red jungle fowl

name: egg
trans: n. animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and protective envelopes…

name: hungry
trans: adj. feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food; (usually followed by 'for') extremely desirous

name: want
trans: v. feel or have a desire for; want strongly; have need of
n. a state of extreme poverty; the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable

name: and
trans: conj. used to connect words, phrases or clauses; in addition to

name: juice
trans: n. the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking

name: tea
trans: n. a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water; a light midafternoon meal of tea and sandwiches or cakes

name: milk
trans: n. a white nutritious liquid secreted by mammals and used as food by human beings; produced by mammary glands of female mammals for feeding their young
v. take milk from female mammals; exploit as much as possible

name: water
trans: n. binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid…
v. supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams; provide with water

name: thirsty
trans: adj. needing moisture

name: thanks
trans: n. an acknowledgment of appreciation; with the help of or owing to

name: shirt
trans: n. a garment worn on the upper half of the body
v. put a shirt on

name: T-shirt
trans: n. a close-fitting pullover shirt

name: skirt
trans: n. cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist; a garment hanging from the waist; worn mainly by girls and women
v. avoid or try to avoid fulfilling, answering, or performing (duties, questions, or issues); pass around or about; move along the border

name: dress
trans: v. put on clothes; provide with clothes or put clothes on
n. a one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice; clothing of a distinctive style or for a particular occasion

name: socks
trans: n. hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee
v. hit hard

name: shorts
trans: n. trousers that end at or above the knee

name: your
trans: det. belonging to or associated with the person or people being addressed
